test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The curved surface area of a right circular cone is 5904π cm², and the diameter of its base is 72 cm. Find the height (in cm) of the cone.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given: **CSA** = 5904π, **Radius (r)** = 36 cm.

Using **CSA** = πrl ⇒ 5904π = π × 36 × l

l = 5904 ÷ 36 = 164 cm.

Height **h** = √(l² − r²) = √(164² − 36²) = √((164 − 36)(164 + 36)) = √(128 × 200) = √25600 = 160 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 160 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** = 5904π cm²

**Diameter (d)** = 72 cm ⇒ **Radius (r)** = 72 ÷ 2 = 36 cm

**Formula Used:**

1. Curved Surface Area (CSA) of cone = πrl

2. Slant height (l) = √(h² + r²) ⇒ h = √(l² − r²)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea137f3485d156b4be48e44afa6a6a3a7fff37fc15b5fc04e3147d1181c49759.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ π × 36 × l = 5904π

⇒ 36 × l = 5904

⇒ l = 5904 ÷ 36

⇒ l = 164 cm

⇒ h² = l² − r²

⇒ h² = 164² − 36²

⇒ h² = (164 − 36)(164 + 36)

⇒ h² = 128 × 200

⇒ h² = 25600

⇒ h = √25600 = 160 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 160 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cone

The total surface area includes the **curved surface area** and the **base area**: TSA = πr(l + r).

Volume of Cone

The volume of a right circular cone is exactly **one-third** of the volume of a cylinder with the same radius and height: V = (1/3)πr²h.

Pythagorean Relation

In a right circular cone, the **height (h)**, **radius (r)**, and **slant height (l)** always form a right-angled triangle: l² = h² + r².</p
